<fe><02><0e><33><31><34><63><5f><30><31><37><5f><30><30><34><33><00>Snow represents winter.
The sun represents summer.<fe><00><fe><02><0e><33><31><34><63><5f><30><31><37><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Flowers grow in spring, and
leaves change color in fall.<fe><00><fe><02><0e><33><31><34><63><5f><30><31><37><5f><30><30><34><35><00>These changes have been
happening in the forest.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>So this is what it looks\nlike on the inside...

<fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Nature seems to have taken
over.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Originally, the inhabitants
here utilized nature...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>But now, nature is
utilizing the ruins.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Old!? Are you serious!?\nYou're the same age as me!
<fe><02><0a><33><32><32><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>It's hard to walk with\nall these roots.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I wish there was a quicker\nway to get through here.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>I might be able to do\nsomething,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>like enlarge the roots\nor destroy the walls.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>This is a surprise...\nBut we can handle it!
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We must defeat them\nin order to pass.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Now's our chance to get\nthe first hit in.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>So much for that plan.\nEveryone, get ready!!
<fe><02><0a><33><32><33><62><5f><30><30><35><38><00>It's hard to walk with\nall these roots.

<fe><02><0a><33><32><34><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>There's no guarantee that's\nwhere the Accursed is.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><32><34><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>It could be right around\nthe next corner...
<fe><02><0a><33><32><34><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>It also could be a trap.\nLet's be careful.
<fe><02><0a><33><32><34><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>It's hard to walk with\nall these roots.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>It is rather large, so\nthat's to be expected.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Well, they ARE ruins.\n...It's the passage of time.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>So the ruins are crappy because\nit's the passage of time.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Lina, do you even know\nwhat that means?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>I don't know... Were they\nfighting amongst themselves?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>They seem to be fighting\nwith each other...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>Ein, is it okay to just\nstand by and watch?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><38><34><00>I see... Well, let me know\nif you change your mind.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><32><62><5f><30><30><38><35><00>I have a funny feeling\nabout this one...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><31><37><00>It better be. I don't like\ngetting kicked around.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><32><32><00>There's something on\nthe side of the tree.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><34><38><00>This wouldn't happen to be\nyours, would it?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><35><33><00>Don't mention it. It was\nyours in the first place.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><36><36><00>I feel much better,\nnow that you asked.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><36><38><00>Why didn't you just ask in\nthe first place?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><61><5f><30><30><37><31><00>It's my pendant.\nI must have lost it here...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>We're finally back to\nwhere we fell from.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>I'm not sure if magic\nwould help this time...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>Hold on, a monster would've\nhatched from that egg...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>I didn't realize that\nthe parent was nearby.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>Parents never stray far\nfrom their young.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>They'll defend their nest\nfearlessly.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>Let's just forget about it\nand continue upward.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>Can we get up there using\nthis branch?
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>This's one big feather.\nIt must be from that bird.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>I guess we won't be opening\nit anytime soon.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Why don't you try ramming\nit? C'mon, use some muscle.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><35><37><00>Now, we won't have to force\nour way through.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><36><35><00>Looks like we got caught with\nour hand in the cookie jar!
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><37><34><00>I was trying to break it,\nbut the shell's too hard...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><33><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>I agree. Who knows when\nthe mother may return...
<fe><02><0a><33><33><34><61><5f><30><30><30><37><00>We can't afford to let\nour guard down.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><34><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>It's not attacking us,\nso it's not our enemy.
<fe><02><0a><33><33><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>There was a glint of light\nover there!
<fe><02><0a><33><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>I tried to help, but then\nI ended up falling, too...
<fe><02><0a><33><34><33><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>You can't talk your way\nout of this one, Ein!
<fe><02><0a><33><34><33><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>You shouldn't say something\nlike that to a lady.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Why do things like this\nkeep happening to us?
<fe><02><0a><33><35><32><62><5f><30><30><35><35><00>It's not worth it for one\npiece of fruit.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><32><62><5f><30><30><36><39><00>Then why didn't you just\ndrop it over the edge?
<fe><02><0a><33><35><32><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>...It's been a long time,\nand my feet are sore.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><32><62><5f><30><30><38><35><00>There's nothing else here\nbesides the broken egg.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>It won't be my fault if\nmore slimes appear.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><33><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Nelde is said to have many\nhidden paths.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Is it? But, the tree looked\nfine down below.
<fe><02><0a><33><35><34><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>Lina, be quiet! The enemy\nmight hear you...
<fe><02><09><65><34><36><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Be careful<fc><4a> this place \nis high off the ground.
<fe><02><09><65><34><36><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Plus, no one is under\nme to catch me anymore.
<fe><02><0a><33><36><32><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>How do you mistake THAT\nfor the enemy?
<fe><02><0a><33><36><32><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>But how am I supposed\nto hold onto it?

<fe><02><09><65><34><32><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Yes, the squirrel has a home\nand a family to return to.<fe><00><fe><02><09><65><34><32><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It would be bad if it couldn't\nreturn home, right?
<fe><02><09><65><34><32><5f><30><30><31><31><00>Bye-bye squirrly, let's \nplay again some time soon!
<fe><02><0a><33><36><32><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Thank you, Ein. But\nis it okay to keep it?
<fe><02><0a><33><36><33><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>But, what if we all fall\nat the same time?

<fe><02><0a><33><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>But this is the first\ntime I've seen a colony.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><33><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>They're usually located\nfar above the ground.
<fe><02><0a><33><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Thanks. If you have any\nquestions, just ask.
<fe><02><0a><33><37><32><62><5f><30><30><36><37><00>Well, not completely empty...\nThere's air inside, right?
